activity_context.topic_title: Properties of Expectation for Discrete Random Variables

feedback.problem:
A random variable $X$ has the probability distribution given below.

| $x$ | $0$ | $2$ | $4$ | $6$ | $8$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $f(x)$ | $0.3$ | $0.1$ | $0.1$ | $0.3$ | $0.2$ |

Calculate $\text{E}[-0.25X].$
feedback.worked_solution:
First, let's find $\text{E}[X].$ 

The expected value of a discrete random variable $X$ with probability mass function $f(x)$ and sample space $S$ is given by

$$
\text{E}[X]={\sum }_{x\in S}x\cdot f(x).
$$

Summing up the products of each value of $X$ and its associated probability, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{E}[X] & ={\sum }_{x\in S}x\cdot f(x) \\  & =0\cdot 0.3+2\cdot 0.1+4\cdot 0.1+6\cdot 0.3+8\cdot 0.2 \\  & =4.\end{aligned}
$$

Hence, we have 

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{E}[-0.25X] & =-0.25\text{E}[X] \\  & =-0.25\cdot 4 \\  & =-1.\end{aligned}
$$
